how: Runtime-free flatten of the Design Component: conditionals resolved per state, holes substituted, handlers stripped. Inline styles only and self-hosted fonts — probe-faithful AND screenshot-faithful offline.
granularity: data-spec is tagged on the same element component-map.json's selector resolves to; multi-rung components (composer footer/shell/input, modal scrim/card, row/badge) each get their own pair.
round2: 12 states cover six round-2 surfaces: new-session sheet (±checkbox), conversation-actions menu, message context menu, event-source viewer, and light|dark-round2 which shows all six on one grid (prompt card both states, upload single vs multi).

conventions.data-spec: canonical component/state name; component-map.json maps each to its src/journal selector plus status + visual alignment
conventions.data-target: the existing selector a state-matrix specimen implements
conventions.data-style-hover|active|focus: designed pseudo-state declarations as CSS text (not live in static files)
conventions.devtool.*: handoff affordance only — do NOT implement
conventions.scrollbars: Scrollbar pseudo-boxes are scoped to real scroll containers (nav, pre, textarea, div) rather than *; scrollbar-color is set once on html and inherits. Same rendering, far fewer elements carrying pseudo-boxes.

assets.fonts/: InterVariable.woff2 (rsms/inter, OFL) + FiraCode[wght].ttf (google/fonts, OFL, licence alongside)
assets.res/matron-logo-simple.svg: brand mark + agent avatar; referenced 3× per state file
assets.note: static/ is self-contained — every referenced asset lives under static/. Keep it that way when regenerating.
